item.title: Sanriku Oyster Grilling: Iwate's Seaside Oyster Huts — Guide
item.description: The cold, nutrient-rich waters of the Sanriku coast produce some of Japan’s finest oysters. Many fishing villages run ‘kaki-goya’ (oyster huts) where you grill freshly harvested oysters over charcoal yourself. Oyster season peaks from November to March, when the plump, briny bivalves are at their creamiest — often served as all-you-can-eat sessions with seaweed miso soup. 🗓️ At a Glance Location Ofunato, Kamaishi etc.
